John, saw Orum picked Vonage APIs to power your AI Conversation Engine and just dropped the 2026 State of Sales Development report.

Doubling down on AI-led conversations usually surfaces more in-market accounts than a team can personally touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Orum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

John, quick follow-up for Orum.

As growth targets climb, board expectations on pipeline tend to outrun headcount. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Orum needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

John, last bit of proof for Orum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Orum's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Orum either way.
